a11y-architect.does: Audits the Command's static HTML pages against WCAG 2.2 AA and specifies each fix.
a11y-architect.fires: The CDR calls it when a dashboard, DOPE SHEET or SOI page needs an accessibility check.
a11y-architect.gives: Findings with file:line, what a screen reader says now, the fix and the criterion.
a11y-architect.steps: Read the page -> map keyboard focus flow -> check targets and contrast -> specify exact markup fixes.

architect.does: Proposes a design for a new tool or a reshuffle of _tools/, with trade-offs.
architect.fires: The CDR calls it before building a new tool or restructuring scripts.
architect.gives: A design with components, data shapes, script interfaces, trade-offs and sometimes an ADR.
architect.steps: Read current scripts -> list requirements -> propose components -> weigh trade-offs.

bench-engineer.does: Gives the Engineer's opinion on what breaks and the smallest build.
bench-engineer.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief says convene the bench; the other four seats run alongside.
bench-engineer.gives: One opinion under 150 words: position, three reasons, one risk, evidence label, confidence.
bench-engineer.steps: Read the question and three files at most -> judge from its own view -> state position and risk -> stop.
bench-engineer.weak: Never launched. Overlaps with the Operator seat on what breaks.

bench-money.does: Gives the Money seat's opinion on cost, return and who would pay.
bench-money.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief says convene the bench; the other four seats run alongside.
bench-money.gives: One opinion under 150 words: position, three reasons, one risk, evidence label, confidence.
bench-money.steps: Read the question and three files at most -> judge from its own view -> state position and risk -> stop.

bench-operator.does: Gives the Operator's opinion on cost, time and what breaks when Chief is away.
bench-operator.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief says convene the bench; the other four seats run alongside.
bench-operator.gives: One opinion under 150 words: position, three reasons, one risk, evidence label, confidence.
bench-operator.steps: Read the question and three files at most -> judge from its own view -> state position and risk -> stop.
bench-operator.weak: Never launched. Overlaps with the Engineer seat on what breaks.

bench-skeptic.does: Runs a pre-mortem and names the hidden assumption in an idea.
bench-skeptic.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief says convene the bench; the other four seats run alongside.
bench-skeptic.gives: One opinion under 150 words: position, three reasons, one risk, evidence label, confidence.
bench-skeptic.steps: Read the question and three files at most -> judge from its own view -> state position and risk -> stop.

bench-storyteller.does: Gives the Storyteller's opinion on whether an idea serves the Outliers and the fabula.
bench-storyteller.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief says convene the bench; the other four seats run alongside.
bench-storyteller.gives: One opinion under 150 words: position, three reasons, one risk, evidence label, confidence.
bench-storyteller.steps: Read the question and three files at most -> judge from its own view -> state position and risk -> stop.

chief-of-staff.does: Sorts messages Chief pastes into four tiers and drafts replies in his tone.
chief-of-staff.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief hands over email, notes or threads.
chief-of-staff.gives: A briefing: skipped count, info items, meetings, action items with draft replies.
chief-of-staff.steps: Read the text -> assign one of four tiers -> draft replies -> list what Chief must do by hand.

claim-checker.does: Checks each factual claim in a draft against a primary source.
claim-checker.fires: The CDR calls it before publishing an article or draft.
claim-checker.gives: A table of claims with score, URL and note, plus smallest rewrites for bad claims.
claim-checker.steps: List claims -> find primary sources -> compare -> score supported, weak, unsupported or contradicted.

code-explorer.does: Traces how an existing script or feature works from start to finish.
code-explorer.fires: The CDR calls it before new work on a script it has not read.
code-explorer.gives: Entry points, execution flow, key files, dependencies and advice for new work.
code-explorer.steps: Find entry points -> follow the call chain -> note patterns -> list dependencies.
code-explorer.weak: Overlaps with the built-in Explore agent. Never launched.

collect-lead.does: Leads one collect run: launches haiku extractors and writes the register.
collect-lead.fires: The collect skill launches it when the CDR hands it brief.LEAD.md.
collect-lead.gives: One line per batch plus the register path.
collect-lead.steps: Read brief and plan -> launch one PS per batch -> check extract files parse -> write the register.

conversation-analyzer.does: Reads a transcript and lists behaviors Chief had to correct.
conversation-analyzer.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief wants repeat mistakes turned into rules.
conversation-analyzer.gives: Behaviors with evidence, frequency, severity and a one-line suggested rule.
conversation-analyzer.steps: Read the transcript -> find corrections and repeats -> rate severity -> propose rule lines.
conversation-analyzer.weak: Overlaps with skill-optimizer on reading transcripts. Never launched.

cto.does: Answers hardware and workstation questions with options, cost and a recommendation.
cto.fires: The CDR calls it for mocap gear, GPU or storage buying questions.
cto.gives: Two to four options with cost, fit with the box, risk and one rec.
cto.steps: Restate the question -> list options -> check fit with the RTX 3090 box -> recommend buy, wait or build.

doc-updater.does: Keeps READMEs and code maps matching the actual scripts.
doc-updater.fires: The CDR calls it when scripts changed and docs may be stale.
doc-updater.gives: Refreshed doc files whose paths and commands it checked.
doc-updater.steps: List the directory -> read entry points -> write the named docs -> verify every path.

drill-maker.does: Writes five recall questions, or practical exercises, from Chief's locked parts.
drill-maker.fires: The CDR calls it during the teach-back loop for a drill.
drill-maker.gives: Five explain-it questions, each with its answer as a tip; no scores.
drill-maker.steps: Read locked parts and say-lines -> write one question per part -> attach a tip to each.

harness-optimizer.does: Reviews the Command's hooks, skills, agents and CLAUDE.md for reliability and token cost.
harness-optimizer.fires: The CDR calls it when session cost or setup reliability needs a review.
harness-optimizer.gives: A harness report with proposals, undo steps, grades and a READY or BLOCKED status.
harness-optimizer.steps: Read the baseline -> define checks -> propose small reversible edits -> grade each.
harness-optimizer.weak: Overlaps with skill-optimizer on skill quality. Never launched.

loop-operator.does: Watches a long detached run from its logs and recommends continue, pause or stop.
loop-operator.fires: The CDR calls it during pull waves or queue runs.
loop-operator.gives: A state (progressing, stalled, failing), evidence and a recommendation.
loop-operator.steps: Read checkpoint and log -> count done and failed -> spot stalls and retries -> recommend.

marketing-agent.does: Plans campaigns and writes copy for the Command's ventures.
marketing-agent.fires: The CDR calls it for landing pages, emails, ads or social posts.
marketing-agent.gives: Copy as text: positioning, landing page, emails, posts, ads, scripts, calendar.
marketing-agent.steps: Scope the job -> research audience and rivals -> lock positioning -> write and review copy.

mle-reviewer.does: Reviews data and model scripts for leakage, weak evaluation and silent failures.
mle-reviewer.fires: The CDR calls it after audio feature, embedding or scoring scripts change.
mle-reviewer.gives: Findings with file:line, most severe first.
mle-reviewer.steps: Read the diff -> pick the stage -> check against the leakage and reproducibility list.

network-troubleshooter.does: Diagnoses connectivity, DNS or slow-link problems with read-only checks.
network-troubleshooter.fires: The CDR calls it only when the order names the box and allowed commands.
network-troubleshooter.gives: A root cause backed by evidence.
network-troubleshooter.steps: Read the symptom -> test layer by layer -> find the failing layer -> report the cause.
network-troubleshooter.weak: Never launched. Clashes with the no-probing rule unless the order names the box.

opensource-forker.does: Copies a project to a staging folder and strips secrets for release.
opensource-forker.fires: The CDR calls it as stage one of a public release.
opensource-forker.gives: A clean staged copy, .env.example, a fork report and fresh git history.
opensource-forker.steps: Copy to staging -> strip secrets and private references -> write .env.example -> start clean git.

opensource-packager.does: Writes README, license, setup script and other release files for a sanitized project.
opensource-packager.fires: The CDR calls it as stage three, after the sanitizer passes.
opensource-packager.gives: Packaging files in the staging folder.
opensource-packager.steps: Read the staged project -> write README and CLAUDE.md -> add setup script and LICENSE.

opensource-sanitizer.does: Audits a staged project for leaked secrets and private data before release.
opensource-sanitizer.fires: The CDR calls it as stage two, after the forker.
opensource-sanitizer.gives: PASS, FAIL or PASS WITH WARNINGS with findings.
opensource-sanitizer.steps: Scan for secrets -> scan for personal data -> check dangerous files -> give a verdict.

order-parser.does: Turns one garbled dictation line into a clean order.
order-parser.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief's dictation line is unclear.
order-parser.gives: Proword, BOLO, verb, object and confidence.
order-parser.steps: Read the line -> check the SOP garble table -> match BOLO titles -> return the likely order.
order-parser.weak: Never launched. It guesses on short garbles.

performance-optimizer.does: Finds why a Python script is slow or uses too much memory.
performance-optimizer.fires: The CDR calls it when a script runs slow.
performance-optimizer.gives: Measured fix recommendations; it edits nothing.
performance-optimizer.steps: Read the script -> find loops, repeated reads and subprocess calls -> measure -> recommend.

planner.does: Turns a feature request into a phased plan with file paths and checks.
planner.fires: The CDR calls it before building anything over three tasks.
planner.gives: A phased plan with risks and a verification per step.
planner.steps: Restate requirements -> read the code -> break into steps -> order by dependency.

prose-taste.does: Audits a draft against the copy self-audit and prose_lint.py rules.
prose-taste.fires: The CDR calls it on a draft before publishing.
prose-taste.gives: Flagged lines, each with a fix.
prose-taste.steps: Read the draft -> check against the rule list -> flag lines -> give a fix for each.

python-reviewer.does: Reviews changed Python scripts for security, errors, Windows pitfalls and style.
python-reviewer.fires: The CDR calls it after scripts change.
python-reviewer.steps: Read the diff -> check security and errors -> check Windows paths and encoding -> rank findings.
python-reviewer.weak: Overlaps with security-reviewer and silent-failure-hunter. Never launched.

pytorch-build-resolver.does: Diagnoses PyTorch and CUDA failures from a traceback.
pytorch-build-resolver.fires: The CDR calls it when a model script crashes.
pytorch-build-resolver.gives: The smallest fix, proposed but not applied.
pytorch-build-resolver.steps: Read the traceback -> read the code -> find the shape or device cause -> propose a fix.

refactor-cleaner.does: Removes dead code, unused imports and duplicate helpers from named scripts.
refactor-cleaner.fires: The CDR calls it when scripts need cleanup.
refactor-cleaner.gives: Cleaned scripts, each checked to compile and start.
refactor-cleaner.steps: Find one safe category -> remove it -> compile and start the script -> repeat.

root-cause.does: Walks a bug through root-cause steps before any fix.
root-cause.fires: The CDR calls it when something behaves wrongly.
root-cause.gives: Symptom, evidence chain with file:line, root cause, smallest fix, proof.
root-cause.steps: State the symptom -> gather evidence -> find the cause -> propose the smallest fix.

sci-biomed.does: Checks biology and medicine in a scene for plausibility in the story's eras.
sci-biomed.fires: The CDR calls it for scenes with injury, disease or dosing.
sci-biomed.steps: Read the scene -> check physiology -> word findings with limits.

sci-forecast.does: Sets out what technology could exist in eras 3 and 4.
sci-forecast.fires: The CDR calls it for future-tech worldbuilding questions.
sci-forecast.gives: Favorable, adverse, wild-card and second-order cases with confidence.
sci-forecast.steps: Take the era -> frame four cases -> rate confidence.

sci-literature.does: Finds published papers on a question through OpenAlex.
sci-literature.fires: The CDR calls it when a story or canon question needs sources.
sci-literature.gives: Sources with DOI, one-line findings and thin-evidence flags.
sci-literature.steps: Search OpenAlex -> read abstracts -> list DOI and finding -> flag thin evidence.

sci-physics.does: Answers orbital, habitat, Moon and energy questions with numbers.
sci-physics.fires: The CDR calls it for ASTRO7EX and space physics questions.
sci-physics.gives: The number, the formula and the assumptions.
sci-physics.steps: Restate the question -> pick the formula -> compute -> list assumptions.

sci-plausibility.does: Flags impossible or unexplained points in a scene or canon node.
sci-plausibility.fires: The CDR calls it on scenes before they lock.
sci-plausibility.gives: Each issue with the line, the problem and two ways to keep it.
sci-plausibility.steps: Read the scene -> flag the impossible -> offer two fixes each.
sci-plausibility.weak: Overlaps with the other sci seats. Never launched.

security-reviewer.does: Reviews scripts and pages for leaked secrets, private data and injection.
security-reviewer.fires: The CDR calls it before pushing public pages or scripts.
security-reviewer.gives: Findings by severity with a fix.
security-reviewer.steps: Scan for secrets -> check private data in public files -> check injection and unsafe fetches.

seo-specialist.does: Reviews public pages for titles, meta tags, structured data and sitemap.
seo-specialist.fires: The CDR calls it for public sites.
seo-specialist.steps: Read the page -> check titles and headings -> check meta and structured data -> rank fixes.

silent-failure-hunter.does: Finds swallowed errors and green runs that skipped work.
silent-failure-hunter.fires: The CDR calls it on scripts that report success too easily.
silent-failure-hunter.gives: Each failure with location, impact and fix.
silent-failure-hunter.steps: Read the script -> find broad excepts and fallbacks -> judge impact -> give a fix.

skill-builder.does: Drafts or trims one skill or agent file from a brief.
skill-builder.fires: The CDR calls it when a new skill or agent file is needed.
skill-builder.gives: The one file the brief names, plus test prompts.
skill-builder.steps: Read the brief -> draft frontmatter and body -> push detail to references -> name test prompts.

skill-optimizer.does: Finds where one skill misfired or dragged in one transcript.
skill-optimizer.fires: The CDR calls it when a skill felt slow or wrong.
skill-optimizer.gives: The smallest edit to the skill; it edits nothing.
skill-optimizer.steps: Read transcript and skill -> check trigger and skipped steps -> find re-reads -> propose an edit.

syllabus-builder.does: Maps a topic into a bare tree of parts in teaching order.
syllabus-builder.fires: The CDR calls it when Chief starts learning a new topic.
syllabus-builder.gives: A bare tree of one-line parts with prerequisites.
syllabus-builder.steps: Read the topic note and locked parts -> list parts -> order by prerequisite.

teach-coach.does: Teaches one tiny part of a topic from a source note.
teach-coach.fires: The CDR calls it for each step of the teach-back loop.
teach-coach.gives: One spoken sentence, one tip and the next part's name.
teach-coach.steps: Read the note and locked parts -> pick the next part -> say the idea -> add a tip.
teach-coach.weak: Never launched. It will not fill gaps the note leaves.
